name: Lomo / punta de anca a la parrilla
pairing_logic: Protein and fat soften tannin; Maillard flavors bridge with oak and dark fruit
recommended_wine_styles: Cabernet Sauvignon; Malbec; Rioja Crianza; Marselan
notes_for_demo: Best core dish for explaining tannin plus protein and intensity matching

name: Cerdo asado / pork belly
main_ingredients: pork; fat; roasted skin; glaze optional
pairing_logic: Acidity and bubbles cut fat; fruity reds complement pork sweetness
recommended_wine_styles: Pinot Noir; Malbec; Chardonnay; Prosecco Brut
notes_for_demo: Useful for comparing contrast pairing versus complement pairing

name: Salmón a la parrilla
pairing_logic: Fat needs acidity; moderate intensity allows both rich whites and low-tannin reds
recommended_wine_styles: Chardonnay; Pinot Noir; Albariño; sparkling brut
notes_for_demo: Excellent edge case because fish can pair with red wine if tannin is low

name: Ceviche
main_ingredients: white fish or seafood; lime; onion; cilantro; chili optional
pairing_logic: High acid in food needs high-acid wine; freshness and salinity bridge with coastal whites
notes_for_demo: Best dish for teaching acidity matching and conflict with oaky/tannic wines

name: Pasta con salsa de tomate
main_ingredients: pasta; tomato; olive oil; garlic; basil; parmesan optional
pairing_logic: Tomato acidity needs an acidic red; herbal notes bridge with savory Sangiovese profile
recommended_wine_styles: Chianti; Sangiovese; Rioja Crianza; Pinot Noir
notes_for_demo: Clear educational example for acid-to-acid matching

name: Risotto de hongos
pairing_logic: Creaminess benefits from acidity; mushroom earthiness bridges with Pinot Noir and aged reds
notes_for_demo: Useful for teaching umami, texture and earthy flavor bridges

name: Pollo con mole / salsa especiada con cacao
pairing_logic: Spice and bitterness can clash with high tannin; fruit and moderate sweetness can soften heat
recommended_wine_styles: Malbec; Pinot Noir; off-dry white; sparkling demi-sec
notes_for_demo: Good controlled case for explaining conflict avoidance with tannin and spice

name: Tabla de quesos: fresco, manchego y azul
main_ingredients: fresh cheese; manchego or aged cheese; blue cheese
pairing_logic: Different cheeses test different rules: freshness with acid, aged cheese with tannin, blue cheese with sweetness
recommended_wine_styles: Sauvignon Blanc; Rioja Crianza; sweet white; sparkling brut
notes_for_demo: High educational value because one board demonstrates multiple pairing principles
